brief:
American actress Angelina Jolie shared before-and-after Google Maps satellite images on social media showing the extent of destruction across Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The images displayed changes to the territory's landscape over time, documenting widespread damage across multiple locations.

Jolie's post accompanied the caption "See what was done to Gaza," directing attention to the scale of devastation visible in the comparative imagery.
dek: 'See what was done to Gaza': Angelina Jolie shares images of destruction American actress Angelina Jolie has posted before-and-after Google Maps satellite images showing the scale of destruction across Gaza.
title: Angelina Jolie posts satellite images of Gaza destruction
